The order says it becomes effective on the third day after it is filed with the Division of the Federal Register; the held text records filing on June 11, 1941, so it took effect on June 14, 1941. The permission is limited by its own terms to the quota year ending September 30, 1941, so it expired when that quota year ended. I record the end as September 30, 1941 inclusive (the permission runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading is that it ended when October 1, 1941 began.
